newsitem.title: USA: HL&P 1,250 MW Texas nuke hits full power.
newsitem.headline: HL&P 1,250 MW Texas nuke hits full power.

text.p: Houston Lighting & Power Co's 1,250 megawatt (MW) South Texas nuclear power unit 1 was operating at full power early Tuesday following a weekend outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said.
The NRC in its daily plant status report Tuesday said the unit was operating at 100 percent of capacity.
South Texas 1, located in Palacios, Texas, was shut down over the weekend for testing, the NRC said.
The adjacent 1,250 MW South Texas unit 2 was also operating at full capacity as of early Tuesday, the NRC said.
HL&P is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
